title: Nirvana and Arcadia
audit_comment: NIRVANA and ARCADIA, printed pp. 84-87, the first two named planes of the Planes of Power in one round: Nirvana the clockwork plane of ultimate Law (the infinite interlocking disks at 500 miles plus, the per-disk gravity with the walk-over-the-edge rule, the air-filled void, the 1/100-turn realm pull, the light-green and deep-red portals cycling once per disk revolution at 20 days on Primus's plane, the always-open Concordant Opposition portal beneath Primus's disk, the no-illusion rule - phantasms as thin smoke fooling no one, Primus the One and Prime with the modrons and Anu's Way, and the pantheons - Anu, Shang-Ti with the peaches and the library of lost knowledge, Shan-Hai Ching, Varuna, Rudra and Yama, Horus, Utu and Enki); and Arcadia the orchard plane of law for the common good (the half-radiant half-black day sphere with its dawnless Prime-length day, the three layers, the metallic trees with double-strength potion fruit spoiling in 1-10 days, the pupilless-eyed watch beasts immune to Prime spells, the ivory and steel archway portals with the 1-in-10 mist and the 90/10 sides rule, the spirit-folk militias with their divination over the static, and the Powers - Marduk the Valiant with the kirdari, and Clanggedin Silverbeard the dwarven Father of Battle with his fortress mountain and his Acheron raids).

banner.title: NIRVANA AND ARCADIA - printed pp. 84-87, the first two named planes in one round: the clockwork plane of ultimate Law with Primus and the modrons, and the orchard plane of law for the common good with its potion fruit, watch beasts and warrior Powers.
banner.provenance: verified against printed pp. 84-87 of the uploaded motp.pdf OCR; the two planes ride together as the Law pair at the top of the wheel (the R572 multi-plane pattern), each carrying its structure, portals, magic rules and Powers exactly as printed.
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 61 closed, 29 open - TWO boxes fall (Nirvana, Arcadia); the Seven Heavens and the Twin Paradises continue the Upper Planes next.

consts.name: ddgDiskRadiusMiles
consts.comment: the Nirvana clockwork: a single infinite plane filled with huge interlocking wheels like the cogs of an ornately carved clock - great platters of matter each 500 miles or more in radius, interlocking at their edges so the entire plane spins in unison; the void between disks is air, so flying is possible.

consts.name: ddgRealmPullTurns
consts.comment: the Nirvana float rule: each disk has its own gravity (toward the disk center, so one walks over the edge onto the far side); beyond any disk's pull a traveler floats as in the Astral, but a subtle tug from nearby realms pulls him within 1/100 turns (as printed) - usually only one side of a disk is inhabited.

consts.name: ddgPortalCycleDays
consts.comment: the Nirvana portals: circles light-green to Arcadia, deep red to Acheron, appearing regularly once per revolution of each disk (on Primus's plane every 20 days) and remaining open for a day; Primus is strict, and few Acheron warbands or Arcadian huntsmen get through - the Concordant Opposition portal is open at all times, on the underside of Primus's disk.

consts.name: ddgFruitSpoilDays
consts.comment: the Arcadian trees: metallic bark (copper, gold, silver or iron), leaves that never fall, and fruit always available with magical powers - picked fruit lasts 1-10 days regardless of preservation and duplicates a DOUBLE-STRENGTH magical potion, the type rolled randomly (DMG or UA tables); each species grows only one type.

consts.name: ddgArchMistDenom
consts.comment: the Arcadian portals: few and permanent, marked by arched trellises of white ivory or black steel; passable normally, but 1 time in 10 the archway mists over into a color pool - white to the Seven Heavens, black to Concordant Opposition, silvery to Nirvana.

consts.name: ddgArchBothSidesPct
consts.comment: the archway sides rule: 90% of the time both sides of an Arcadian archway lead to the same portal on the other plane, but 10% of the time the two sides lead to different locations - and Prime portals sit at the center of a realm's topmost side, leading to planes where the realm's Powers are worshiped.

bools.name: ddgNirvanaNoIllusion
bools.comment: the Nirvana magic rule: all spells function normally EXCEPT illusions and phantasms - spells with illusionary or phantasmal components do not work in the plane of ultimate Law; at best they appear as thin wavy bits of smoke in the general shape of what was intended, fooling no one, least of all the natives.

bools.name: ddgPrimusDoctrine
bools.comment: Primus the One and Prime: the greatest of the modrons, dwelling (it is said) in a pool of energy at the center of the plane; most Astral silver pools and conduits open into his realm; base modrons serve throughout Nirvana's realms; he can send a beseeching traveler to Arcadia or Acheron, to the plane most akin to his alignment; when Anu travels, the temporary conduit Anu's Way bridges Nirvana and the Prime, and Marduk is summoned from Arcadia to mind his realm.

bools.name: ddgNirvanaPantheon
bools.comment: the Nirvana Powers: Anu the Babylonian judge (a 1,000-mile disk city, soldiers gilt in copper with pupilless yellow eyes, Anutu at his side); Shang-Ti the Jade Emperor (the Celestial Bureaucracy, Wang the transcendental doorkeeper, foo dogs and lions, ever-ripe peach trees - longevity as the potion, immortality for Powers - and the library of all lost Prime knowledge, collected by faceless grey-cloaked giants from doomed places); Shan-Hai Ching's watery wheel irrigating the peaches; the Indian trio Varuna, Rudra and Yama; Horus the Avenger with his hawk servants; and Utu the chaotic-good Sumerian sun god with Enki as his watcher, linked by a bridge of woven gold and crystal.

bools.name: ddgArcadiaDaySphere
bools.comment: the Arcadian day: a great sphere set into the highest peak, half radiant and half black - Positive and Negative Material brought together without destruction or melding into shadow; its revolution matches a Prime day, but the Arcadian day is dawnless and duskless (light appears suddenly), split evenly between night and day.

bools.name: ddgArcadiaLayers
bools.comment: the Arcadian structure: three layers, the lower reaches unexplored; the uppermost layer is many well-organized realms sharing a common gravity - gentle showers, rainbow flowers in well-ordered untended patches, cities in geometrically perfect shapes, mountains unblemished by erosion.

bools.name: ddgArcadiaWatchBeasts
bools.comment: the Arcadian animals: golden foxes, coppery hares, silver-wooled sheep, and organized insects - peaceful, unaffected by Prime spells that touch their kind (as outer-planar natives), mute but with pupilless white eyes that pierce any illusion or phantasm - excellent watch beasts.

bools.name: ddgArcadiaMilitia
bools.comment: the Arcadian militias: spirit-folk patrols (einheriar, Appendix III) hunting creatures that do not belong - good and lawful creatures are greeted and offered to ride along, neutrals are stiffly asked their business, evil and chaotic creatures are attacked; as natives the militias can use divination over the background static of the plane.

bools.name: ddgArcadiaPowers
bools.comment: the Arcadian Powers: Marduk the Valiant (the Babylonian champion, city at the crossing of the rivers Kath and Laur, home of the kirdari warriors sent to aid his mythos, good regardless of Law-Chaos disposition, sole restriction against dragonkind); and Clanggedin Silverbeard (UA 110), the dwarven Father of Battle - a conical fortress mountain near the light-and-darkness sphere, his warriors forever practicing siegecraft against their own citadel, raids against the evil-dwarf and duergar hosts of Acheron, maximum damage at minimum risk, and good terms with Marduk; a barrier to Arcadia's second layer lies beneath his audience hall.
